question: Which river in India flows through a rift valley?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Narmada.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **T****he Narmada and the Tapi** are the major rivers in India that flow through **rift valleys**. 
 
• The Narmada originates on the western flank of the Amarkantak plateau at a height of about 1,057 m.
 
• The other rivers which flow through the rift valley include the **Damodar River** in Chota Nagpur Plateau and Tapti
 
• The **Tapti River and Mahi River **also flow through rift valleys, but between different ranges.
 
• There are **three** rivers in India that flow through a rift valley. The two other rivers which flow through a rift valley are Damodar and Narmada.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• A rift valley is **a lowland region that forms where Earth's tectonic plates move apart or rift**.
 
• Rift valleys are found both on land and at the bottom of the ocean, where they are created by the process of seafloor spreading.
 
• The linear depression may subsequently be further deepened by the forces of erosion
 
• In India **on the southern slopes of the Vindhyachal mountain ranges, at the Malwa plateau escarpment boundary** is formed, under which the rift valley is formed and the Narmada river flows in this valley in the west direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Periyar river is the longest river in Kerala. 

 
 
• It is popularly known as the lifeline of Kerala.
 
• The length of the Periyar river is 244 km.
 
• It originates from Sivagiri Hills in the Western Ghats and empties into Kodungallur lake.
 
• It passes through two states: Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
 
• The major Tributaries are:
 
 
• Muthirapuzha River
 
• Mullayar River
 
• Cheruthoni River
 
• Perinjankutti River
 
• Edamala River
 
 
 
 
 
• The Penganga River is a tributary of the **Wardha River**, which is a tributary of the Pranhita River, which flows into the **Godavari**.
 
• Son river originates from the Amarkantak plateau in the Anuppur district of Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
• It flows through Madhya Pradesh, Chhatisgarh, Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand and finally joins Ganga in Bihar near Patna.
 
• Ghaghra, Johilla, Chhoti Mahanadi, Gopad, Rihand, Kanhar, and North Koel are the tributaries of the Son river.
 
• The Bansagar Dam in Madhya Pradesh is also on the Son river.
